resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register says the current cab went into service in 1963. A Forest Service bid notice from August 1963 was still advertising construction, a 1968 item says a contractor erected the present lookout, and a plaque dates the attached stairs to summer 1964. The record keeps 1963 as the register date and flags the rest as unsettled.

notes_for_editor: Register number conflict, not resolved: the NHLR page for this lookout prints US 594, CA 65 (kept in the record). The firelookout.org California list (fetched from cache) shows NHLR US 883, CA 93 for Sierra Buttes and US 594, CA 65 for a Sierra Peak in Orange/Riverside, so one of the numbers may be wrong. The brief's conflict note says the two share a number. The Forest Service trail page also shows a phone line with 'Open by appointment only'; that appears to be a district office contact, not the lookout, and was not used. Current staffing and visiting rules are unverified: the last dated staffing source is 1992, and the 2024 Ukiah article is a visitor account. The 1954 storehouse loss is not the lookout itself. The 1926 report relied on telephone messages and is hedged in the event note. No photos added.
